name: digital-workplace-collaboration-suite
known_facts: One tool per use case prevents tool fatigue
Governance should be enforced at platform level, not user training
Notification overload is the top productivity killer in collaboration tools
Every collaboration tool should support SSO and SCIM
Retention and e-discovery requirements should drive tool choice

input.current_tools: M365 E5, Teams, Slack (10 pilot teams), Zoom, Dropbox, Box, Confluence, Trello
input.pain_points: Tool fatigue, notification overload, document chaos (files in Teams, Box, AND Dropbox), poor meeting culture
input.compliance_requirements: GDPR, SOC 2, client data residency requirements (EU, US, APAC)
input.chat_governance: Retention: 1 year for standard, 7 years for client engagements
input.meeting_secondary: Zoom (licensed for client-facing only, sunset internal Zoom within 3 months)
input.meeting_governance: Recording policy: recorded meetings retained 90 days, auto-delete unless marked
input.meeting_training: Meeting etiquette guide for async-first culture
input.doc_secondary: Box (phased out, migration to SharePoint Online)
input.doc_governance: External sharing requires Azure AD conditional access and DLP policy
input.doc_training: SharePoint migration training for power users only
input.project_governance: Project templates enforce standardized phases and deliverables
input.project_training: Planner training for project managers, self-serve guides for team members
input.wiki_secondary: Confluence (migrate to Loop, export legacy spaces)
input.wiki_governance: Wiki owners assigned per business unit, quarterly content reviews
input.wiki_training: Loop training for knowledge managers in each business unit
input.esign_governance: Approval workflows in Power Automate, audit trail in Purview
input.esign_training: Self-serve guides, one-pager for approval flow setup
input.email_governance: Retention: 7 years default, legal hold enabled for litigation
input.value_1: Create tasks from chat without switching context
input.value_2: Signed documents stored automatically in engagement folder
input.value_3: Adoption metrics pushed to leadership Teams channel weekly
input.value_4: DLP policies enforced on document sharing, compliance reporting automated
input.naming_policy: Business Unit > Project > Document Type > Version
input.naming_enforcement: SharePoint retention labels and file plan
input.retention_policy: 7 years default, 1 year for transitory content, indefinite for legal hold
input.retention_enforcement: Purview retention labels auto-applied via sensitivity labels
input.access_policy: Least privilege with Azure AD PIM for elevated access
input.access_enforcement: Azure AD conditional access, Entra ID governance reviews
input.external_policy: External sharing requires MFA and DLP check
input.external_enforcement: Azure AD B2B with terms of use acceptance
input.notification_policy: Default: off for @mentions only, opt-in for channel notifications
input.notification_enforcement: Teams messaging policy assigned to all users
input.pilot_activities: Select 2 business units, deploy Teams as primary chat, migrate active Slack channels
input.early_activities: Expand to 5 business units, roll out Planner and Loop, begin Box migration
input.early_audience: Early adopter program (500 users across all regions)
input.early_metric: Tool consolidation ratio (tools used per person per week)
input.org_activities: Organization-wide rollout, Zoom internal sunset, Trello migration
input.org_metric: Adoption rate by tool > 80%, support tickets < 50/week
input.optimize_activities: Review adoption data, adjust governance, retire unused tools
input.optimize_metric: Tool count reduced to M365 core + DocuSign, NPS > 60
